If the peg is not on a market increment, the working price will be next available market increment in the signed direction. For example, a primary buy peg of .025 when the market bid is 0.490 will work at 0.520 (bid+0.030) since prices greater than $0.50 are in whole penny increments. Order rejected if Peg Differenceis specified without Conditional Flag(8002) = 0 (Conditional Order) or 1 (firm-up of conditional). CCbbooee CCaannaaddaa NNEEOO:: Optional tag for use with Primary Peg orders (Exec Inst= R). If not sent or sent with a zero value, the order will peg directly to its respective side of the PNBBO. Signed dollar value up to two (three) decimal places is added to result of peg calculation when the peg difference is at or above (below) $0.50. NOTE: Only non-aggressive offsets are supported for visible primary pegs, i.e., pegging at or away from the PNBBO; visible buy orders cannot have a positive value, and visible sell orders cannot have a negative value.
